measurements.stage_scope: Derived from rounded native SVG widths, about +/-1 gate; not runtime stage measurement

measurements.diagnostic_limitation: Confirms severe low-weight approximation behavior, consistent with upstream omissions. Does not prove exact failing branches, ordinary-distribution correctness, general pole/phase safety, or any lower failure-rate bound.
